story-context.title: Eval Judge Package + Rubric ADR
story-context.overview: Add the judge-package and judge-ingest layer to the Form AI eval harness. This story keeps judging manual via Cursor multi-model chats and avoids new model API clients. It locks rubric_v1, creates the judge package generator, validates/ingests judge JSON outputs, and documents the workflow for Anthony.

critical-objectives.item: Keep all judge execution manual via Cursor chats; no new API keys, HTTP clients, or secrets.
File-version rubric_v1.md and govern future rubric changes through the rubric ADR.
Generate deterministic, anonymised judge packages from existing eval run artifacts.
Validate judge JSON strictly before ingest; fail loud on missing, duplicate, unknown, or out-of-range rows.
Compute Claude+Gemini primary means and GPT-5 mini self-bias deltas, leaving statistical verdicts to 6.4.3c.

constraints.item: Do NOT implement live judge model API calls.
Do NOT add Welch/Fisher statistics or diff reports; 6.4.3c owns that.
Do NOT mutate prompts.yaml or benchmark set version.
Do NOT run Alembic. No migration expected unless Dev discovers 6.4.3a schema is insufficient.
Eval package data is PII-adjacent; scrub obvious generated sensitive values and keep raw package artifacts local/in-repo only as appropriate.
